facts.fact: A national technical workshop held 7-10 April 2026 mapped existing health tools, identified priority data-exchange flows, defined common technical standards including HL7 FHIR and explored mediation solutions, as part of the ministry's plan for an interoperable health information system; Agence Ecofin reports that neither timeline nor budget has been made public.

Agence Ecofin, citing the Ministry of Public Health and the Fight against AIDS, reports that DHIS2, SIDAInfo and OpenClinic coexist without really communicating with each other, causing duplication and inconsistencies.

systems.owner: Ministry of Public Health and the Fight against AIDS
